title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Friday two more cast members for Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot . Both characters will appear in the show's 15th episode on October 18.
author: ANN

title: 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Reveals Main Cast, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nanai Umihoshi 's Kizuguchi to Houtai ( Wound and Bandage ) manga revealed the main cast, a theme visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere on January 9, 2027 at 11:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Magical DoReMi, Star Detective Precure! Anime Get Crossover Episode on October 25
content: The official website for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise , revealed on Friday that the anime will have a crossover episode with the Ojamajo Doremi ( Magical DoReMi ) anime with its 39th episode on October 25.
author: ANN

title: Singer Kenshi Yonezu Goes on World Tour in Early 2027
content: Sony Music announced on Thursday that singer-songwriter Kenshi Yonezu will go on a concert world tour in early 2027. The tour is titled " KENSHI YONEZU 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR / GHOST." title: Crunchyroll Streams Dub for The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will begin streaming an English dub for the third anime season based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Season 2 Finally Debuts Mereoleona’s Fieriest Form After 5 Years
content: Black Clover Season 2 doesn’t waste time before getting into action as the Magic Knights and mages from the Heart Kingdom attack the Spade Kingdom. The anime returns after five years with more stunning visuals than ever.
author: ComicBook

title: GKIDS Offers CITY the Animation on BD Collector's Edition on December 15
content: GKIDS announced on Thursday that it will release Kyoto Animation 's CITY The Animation , the television anime of Keiichi Arawi 's CITY manga, in a Collector's Edition Blu-ray Disc that will be available exclusively on its online store on December 15.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump’s Newest and Hottest Leading Manga Is Fixing One of Shonen’s Biggest Flaws
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump has produced some of the most prominent manga series for decades. However, even among its waves of amazing shonen manga, one element has consistently been lacking, and this new manga series is fixing it perfectly.
author: ComicBook

title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 Hints at Naruto’s Shocking Return
content: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex is returning with its monthly release, and as always, a week before the chapter’s release, it has revealed a sneak peek. Chapter 38 will be featured in the upcoming V-Jump issue, releasing on Tuesday, October 20, in Western regions.
author: ComicBook
